candidateAudit.text: 🇦🇹 Em busca do Schnitzel mais icônico de Viena? 🇦🇹🍽️ 📍 Wien • Austria • O melhor de viajar pelo mundo •••••••••••• 🌊 O Figlmüller não é apenas um restaurante, é uma verdadeira instituição vienense que elevou o Schnitzel a um patamar de arte. O ambiente combina a tradição austríaca com um toque de elegância, tornando cada refeição uma experiência memorável. A textura impecável da carne, batida até ficar fina e crocante, é o que atrai viajantes de todo o mundo para este endereço clássico. 📜 Com uma história que atravessa gerações, o estabelecimento na Bäckerstraße passou por uma renovação completa, mantendo o charme histórico enquanto oferece um espaço moderno e acolhedor. É o lugar perfeito para vivenciar a autêntica cultura gastronômica da capital austríaca, onde a hospitalidade e a qualidade dos ingredientes locais são celebradas em cada prato servido. ___________________ 📹 Figlmüller ___________________ 🎟️ Planeje sua viagem com omelhordeviajarpelomundo! candidateAudit.text: Ich mag die Alte Donau so sehr, auch im Herbst 🍂 - extreeeem schön. Was haben wir WienerInnen für ein Glück in so einer Stadt zu wohnen. 10 Minuten von der City mit der U-Bahn ans Wasser und in eine komplett andere Welt. Bei der Sonntagsrunde habe ich ein paar Lokaltipps gesammelt - von Wirtshausküche bis schick - alle unterschiedlich, alle gut. Für mich zum Merken und wer die Gegend nicht kennt, zum Speichern. + Straßenbahnerbad - mit super schöner, neuer Terrasse und toller Lage. Und Preise, wie man sie an der Alten Donau nicht mehr erwarten würde. 👏 + Polizeibad + Zur Alten Kaisermühle - Super Klassiker, gehobene Küche + Zum Schinakl +Strandcafé, der Spareribs-Klassiker + Landtmann Das Bootshaus. Wahrscheinlich, die Nr.1 in der Gegend + Selbstverständlich + Hofbauer - Ufertaverne Meine persönlichen Favoriten: Bootshaus, Hofbauer, Straßenbahnerbad #wien #altedonau #vienna #viennarestaurants

candidateAudit.title: 🔥 VIENNA’S TRENDIEST NEW RESTAURANT? VIENNESE BEISL MEETS ITALIAN TRATTORIA! 👀🍝 Vienna has a brand-new restaurant concept! Meet NUJE, a stylish yet cozy neighborhood restaurant
candidateAudit.text: 🔥 VIENNA’S TRENDIEST NEW RESTAURANT? VIENNESE BEISL MEETS ITALIAN TRATTORIA! 👀🍝 Vienna has a brand-new restaurant concept! Meet NUJE, a stylish yet cozy neighborhood restaurant that opened in October 2026 in Vienna’s 14th district. The concept? Traditional Viennese Beisl culture meets Italian trattoria vibes! 🇦🇹🇮🇹 Behind NUJE are restaurateur Gaetano Brancato and chef Mario Farina, who previously worked together at Partenope in Vienna. Expect creative Mediterranean cuisine with Austrian influences, homemade pasta, surprising flavor combinations and a relaxed atmosphere that brings together the best of both culinary worlds. And here’s the best part: the prices are surprisingly affordable! 💸 ✨ WHAT MAKES NUJE SPECIAL: 🔥 Brand-new Vienna restaurant – opened October 2026 🇦🇹🇮🇹 Viennese Beisl meets Italian trattoria 👨‍🍳 Chef Mario Farina with over 30 years of culinary experience 🍝 Homemade ravioli filled with Austrian goulash, crispy peppers & sage butter 🥩 Hand-cut Tafelspitz tartare with sea spinach & garlic 🎃 Neapolitan pumpkin with ricotta mousse & crispy sage 🍝 Homemade spaghetti with basil & tomato sauce 🍟 Sweet potato fries with carbonara mayo 🍮 Chestnut Bavarois & traditional Austrian pancakes 🪵 Cozy interior with wooden tables, traditional benches & a vintage bar 🍷 Austrian wines & Mediterranean aperitivo vibes 💰 GREAT VALUE: 🍽️ Lunch menu with starter or soup + main course from €11.90 🥗 Small plates from around €6 🍝 Main courses around €18 🥐 BONUS: SUNDAY BRUNCH! NUJE also offers a Sunday brunch – perfect for a relaxed weekend in Vienna. 📍 NUJE VIENNA Märzstraße 138, 1140 Vienna, Austria 💡 Reservations recommended. ➕ Follow us for Vienna’s coolest new restaurants, hidden gems & unforgettable food experiences! #TasteAndTheCity #NujeVienn
